authority_principles: Host runtime chooses eligible inference seats; it does not own project identity or vault content.
Each repository project rail owns its doctrine pointers, ISA acceptance, and finite GSD planning.
The portfolio map is a reviewed classification projection, not a WorkObject or Goal Graph writer.
The Labs vault owns durable company context and the single guarded Git note transport.
D1 Goal Graph remains the sole operational writer; Hermes remains Telegram transport.
Private credentials, sessions, local databases, raw memory, and runtime logs never enter Git or EC2 sync.
